# WEAVE

> Stories. Culture. What's happening on campus. The modern digital hub for university students.

WEAVE is a digital platform and media network built for university students. It unites student journalism, cultural photography, community discussions, campus services, and podcasts into an integrated experience.

## Key Sections

- [Home](https://warren-weave.vercel.app/): Media hero, trending campus topics, student voice polls, latest blogs, and campus culture snapshots.
- [Blogs](https://warren-weave.vercel.app/blogs): Student-written stories, campus opinions, lifestyle guides, and academic insights.
- [Submit a Blog](https://warren-weave.vercel.app/submit): Public submission portal for students to submit stories and thought pieces for editorial review.
- [Podcasts](https://warren-weave.vercel.app/podcasts): Student-led audio conversations covering faith, careers, relationships, and university life.
- [Culture](https://warren-weave.vercel.app/culture): Visual gallery capturing moments, events, and everyday life across campus.
- [Explore](https://warren-weave.vercel.app/explore): The wider ecosystem of platforms including WAVE (campus networking), PLAWZA (student marketplace and housing), and STITCH (careers and opportunities).
- [About](https://warren-weave.vercel.app/about): Mission, background, and vision behind WEAVE.
- [Contact](https://warren-weave.vercel.app/contact): Direct communication, feedback, and community channels.

## Legal & Policies

- [Privacy Policy](https://warren-weave.vercel.app/privacy): Data collection, usage, and privacy commitments.
- [Terms of Service](https://warren-weave.vercel.app/terms): Platform guidelines and user agreements.
- [Cookie Policy](https://warren-weave.vercel.app/cookies): Information about cookies and local storage.
